title: server: implement validate_straw_man_traps
description: Implement server function to detect and validate straw man argument traps in requirements. This validator identifies weak or misrepresented arguments that could undermine the integrity of the requirement specification.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL analyze all requirement arguments for straw man patterns
THE SYSTEM SHALL maintain a registry of known straw man patterns

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a requirement with argumentative structure is submitted
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL scan for misrepresentation of opposing views

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a potential straw man is detected
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL flag the issue with severity level and explanation
THE SYSTEM SHALL generate a comprehensive trap report

unwanted.condition: IF the argument oversimplifies an opposing viewpoint
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT validate the requirement as complete
unwanted.because: oversimplified arguments lead to poor decision-making

unwanted.condition: IF the requirement attacks a position that was never asserted
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT approve the requirement
unwanted.because: attacking fabricated positions wastes development resources

preconditions: Input must contain structured argumentative content
Pattern recognition models must be loaded and initialized
Context information for the requirement domain must be available
postconditions: Output includes detected straw man instances with locations
Output includes confidence scores for each detection
Output provides remediation suggestions for each trap found
invariants: Detection threshold shall remain consistent across validations
False positive rate shall not exceed acceptable bounds
Analysis shall complete within defined timeout limits

happy: Given a requirement with balanced argument representation, when validate_straw_man_traps is called, then validation passes with no traps detected
Given a requirement with subtle misrepresentation, when validate_straw_man_traps is called, then the trap is detected with appropriate confidence score
Given multiple valid arguments without straw man patterns, when validate_straw_man_traps is called, then all arguments are marked as valid
error: Given an empty requirement text, when validate_straw_man_traps is called, then validation returns EMPTY_INPUT error
Given a requirement with only circular reasoning, when validate_straw_man_traps is called, then validation fails with CIRCULAR_ARGUMENT trap code
Given input exceeding maximum length, when validate_straw_man_traps is called, then validation returns INPUT_TOO_LARGE error with size limit information
